name: Galley table with bench
brief: MK-072 Galley table. Round 2, matched to the pick: a round table on one floor-pinned pedestal with a raised lip so things don't drift off in low gravity, two chunky padded stools with dark bumpers, and a framed food module on the table with a warm glowing rehydrator window and a hatch.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
